stories.title: Video | Trein staat met neus tegen vrachtwagen na botsing in Ermelo

en.title: Video | Train nose-to-nose with truck after collision in Ermelo
en.summary: A train collided with a truck in Ermelo, with the train's front end coming into contact with the vehicle.

stories.title: Trein met 150 passagiers botst op vrachtwagen bij overweg in Ermelo

en.title: Train with 150 passengers collides with truck at level crossing in Ermelo
en.summary: A passenger train carrying approximately 150 people struck a truck at a railway crossing in Ermelo on Monday morning. The condition of the passengers and truck driver remains unclear.

stories.title: Trein botst op vrachtwagen bij Ermelo, treinverkeer ligt hele dag stil

en.title: Train collides with truck near Ermelo, rail traffic halted all day
en.summary: A train with approximately 150 passengers collided with a truck carrying concrete blocks at a railway crossing in Ermelo around 10 AM. Train service was completely suspended for the day while passengers were evacuated and the incident investigated.

stories.title: Pro-leider Jesse Klaver wil ‘ondanks alles’ praten over de begroting

en.title: Pro-leader Jesse Klaver wants to talk about the budget 'despite everything'
en.summary: Jesse Klaver, leader of the Green Left party, expressed willingness to engage with the minority coalition government on next year's budget negotiations.

stories.title: Energierekening huishoudens tientallen euro's hoger door verbouwing stroomnet

en.title: Energy bills for households tens of euros higher due to power grid renovation
en.summary: Household energy bills will rise significantly next year as network maintenance and management costs increase. Electricity costs will rise by 89 euros and gas costs by 52 euros annually, representing nearly 20 percent increases.

stories.title: Energierekening gaat 140 euro per jaar omhoog door sprong in nettarieven

en.title: Energy bill rises 140 euros per year due to jump in network tariffs
en.summary: Dutch household energy bills will increase substantially next year as network tariffs climb. The rise is driven primarily by investments in power grid expansion.

stories.title: Zweedse verkiezingen spannend tot de laatste stem: linkse oppositie lijkt rechts blok nipt te verslaan

en.title: Swedish elections tight to the last vote: left opposition appears to narrowly beat right bloc
en.summary: Swedish election results appear very close, with the left-wing opposition seemingly gaining a narrow victory over the right-wing political bloc.

stories.title: Keja Klaasje Kwestro krijgt toneelprijs Theo d'Or voor F*ck Lolita

en.title: Keja Klaasje Kwestro receives Theo d'Or theater prize for F*ck Lolita
en.summary: Dutch actress Keja Klaasje Kwestro won the Theo d'Or, the Netherlands' most prestigious theater award, for her lead role in F*ck Lolita, a stage adaptation that reframes the protagonist's agency in the story.

stories.title: Theo d’Or-winnares Keja Klaasje Kwestro liet de bezoeker in F*CK LOLITA alle hoeken van de theaterzaal zien

en.title: Theo d'Or winner Keja Klaasje Kwestro showed theatre visitors all corners of the hall in F*CK LOLITA
en.summary: Keja Klaasje Kwestro received the Theo d'Or for best lead performance at the Dutch Theatre Gala, where the prestigious VSCD theatre awards were presented.

stories.title: Keja Klaasje Kwestro wint prestigieuze Theo d’Or voor hoofdrol in theaterhit ‘F*ck Lolita’

en.title: Keja Klaasje Kwestro wins prestigious Theo d'Or for lead role in theatre hit 'F*ck Lolita'
en.summary: Dutch actress Keja Klaasje Kwestro won the prestigious Theo d'Or theatre award for her lead role in the theatrical production F*ck Lolita.

stories.title: Links blok ligt nipt aan kop bij verkiezingen in Zweden

en.title: Left bloc narrowly leads in Swedish elections
en.summary: The Social Democrats hold a narrow lead over the right-wing bloc of Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson in Swedish elections. Final results may not be available until Wednesday.

stories.title: Dynamisch Feyenoord wint met 0-7 van PEC, de grootste thuisnederlaag ooit van de Zwollenaren

en.title: Dynamic Feyenoord wins 0-7 against PEC, the largest home defeat ever for the Zwollenaren
en.summary: Four days after losing to FC Barcelona in the Champions League, Feyenoord defeated PEC Zwolle 7-0 in an away match, setting a negative club record for the home team.
